polls.description: China is launching a massive $295 billion AI infrastructure push while facing increasing restrictions from the US and allies on chip access.
polls.question: Will China's $295B AI buildout succeed despite Western chip restrictions?

cluster_stories.title: China Preps $295 Billion Plan to Fund AI Buildout
cluster_stories.summary: China is planning to spend around 2 trillion yuan ($295 billion) over the next five years to build data centers across the country. Neil Campling reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA PREPS $295 BILLION AI BUILDOUT... Massive Data Center Push

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek close to sealing $7 billion funding in historic AI deal
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek is nearing a massive $7.4 billion funding round, with tech giants Tencent and CATL leading the investment. DeepSeek’s fundraising would mark a new level of ambition from China’s AI leaders as they seek to compete with their American counterparts in the field.
